title: lacking features
body:
Meets the basics but lacking some useful features.

Would be great if it can also allow rearrangements of the various tabs (now it is based on the order of when “new list” was created).

Subtask items should also have its own date/time.

Recurring task should have more than 1 “tick off” function (given that it is recurring).

Not sure what does “move reminders to Tasks” mean.
